drop: Drop an EML, EMLX or MSG file here to export its content
privacy: Your email stays in this browser. No uploads or remote content.
invalid: Choose a readable EML, EMLX or MSG email file.
failed: The email content could not be exported. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This email has missing or unreadable embedded resources. Export a complete copy with supported raster images and try again.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
fidelity: Export a saved email as standalone UTF-8 HTML or plain text, including readable headers, saved dates and an attachment list. The HTML file opens offline with selectable text and supported embedded images.
limitations: Remote resources, scripts, forms and original email styles are omitted. Attachment contents are not included. Encrypted, incomplete and compressed-RTF-only messages cannot be exported. Sender identity, signatures and delivery are not verified.
layoutNotice: HTML uses the readable HTML body when available, otherwise saved plain text. External links open only when selected. Text export prefers the saved plain-text alternative; otherwise text and safe link addresses are extracted from HTML.
missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the document.
protected: Encrypted or protected emails cannot be converted. Export a readable copy from your mail app and try again.
incomplete: This email is incomplete or an embedded resource could not be read. Export a complete copy with its local resources and try again.
rtfOnly: This Outlook email has only a compressed RTF body, which cannot be converted. Save an EML copy with readable HTML or plain text in your mail app and try again.
remoteNotice: Remote images and other external resources were omitted. Nothing was fetched from the sender or a tracking server.
verificationNotice: Sender identity, digital signatures and delivery have not been verified.
styleNotice: This copy uses a simple reading layout. Original styles and active content are omitted.
noBody: This email has no readable message body. Its available headers and attachments are shown above.
invalidDate: The saved date is missing or malformed. It is shown without conversion when available.
utcDate: This Outlook timestamp is stored in UTC. The original sender’s time zone is not available.
signed: This message contains a digital signature. Signature validity is not checked.
attachmentNotice: Only attachment names, types, sizes and roles are listed. Attached files and attached emails are not included in this export.
copyFailed: The text could not be copied. Select it manually or download the TXT file.
plainNotice: Plain text does not contain images or formatting. It uses the saved text alternative when available, otherwise readable text and safe link addresses from HTML.
